Schematic part is a 27C256 EPROM. J3 (ROM_1) and J4 (ROM_27) let pins 1 and 27 be set for either type: on a 27C256 pin 1 is VPP and pin 27 is A14; on a 28C256 pin 1 is A14 and pin 27 is /WE. Options: AT28C256-15PU EEPROM (reprogrammable), AT27C256R-45PU (OTP), or a OneROM. Normal socket, no ZIF.
